Divider.blurb: A rule on the line token, so the one place needing it does not hard-code a colour.

Surface.blurb: The five container recipes - card, tile, field, sunken, floating - instead of a drifting radius/border/shadow class string.

Text.blurb: The whole type scale as one component. Without it every screen re-types the sizes by hand, which is where drift starts.

Wordmark.blurb: Mark plus name lockup; the mark itself is a slot.

Grid.blurb: A CSS grid with a column count per breakpoint or a minimum card width that auto-fills, plus GridItem spans that still mean full when columns change.

TextLink.blurb: The inline link: ink text on an accent underline, new-tab links with an arrow, hidden notice and safe rel, router rendering through as.

FocusTrap.blurb: Focus containment and restore, written once. Every dialog, drawer and menu in the library shares it.

Portal.blurb: Renders into a node outside the current tree. Modal, Drawer, Toast, Popover and ContextMenu all need it.

Presence.blurb: Keeps a node mounted long enough to animate out, and owns the timers so its callers do not have to.

SkipLink.blurb: Hidden until focused; depends only on the focus tokens.

VisuallyHidden.blurb: Text for screen readers only. Every icon-only control needs one.

LiveRegion.blurb: Screen reader announcements through useAnnounce, polite or assertive, with repeated messages spoken again and old text cleared after a delay.

HighlightMatch.blurb: Wraps search matches in accent-tinted marks, ignoring case and accents, matching each word on its own and treating regex characters literally.

AppShell.blurb: The floating rounded window on a tinted canvas; full-bleed below xl.

BentoGrid.blurb: The mixed-span card grid the overview page lays out.

Card.blurb: A titled container with an optional action and a body slot - the shape most content ends up in.

PageHeader.blurb: Title block with actions, for secondary routes.

PromoBanner.blurb: A hero strip: headline, highlighted phrase, supporting link, call to action, and a slot for artwork.

SplitPane.blurb: Two panes and a divider that moves by pointer or arrow key, announced as a splitter with its position.

AspectRatio.blurb: Holds a box to a ratio before its media loads, with CSS aspect-ratio and object-cover, so thumbnail grids never jump as images arrive.

Stack.blurb: Flex row or column with gaps on the spacing scale, direction that can change per breakpoint, and dividers that sit centred in the gap and turn with it.

Container.blurb: The centred page column: width presets from the site shell and its own gutters, so pages line up with the header. ContainerBleed runs a child to the edge.

Sticky.blurb: position: sticky that reports when it has pinned, through data-stuck, a class or a render prop, watched by a sentinel with no scroll listener.

MasterDetail.blurb: List and detail side by side when wide, one pane at a time when narrow, with focus sent to the detail heading and back to the row.

DashboardGrid.blurb: Widgets rearranged by dragging a handle or with Space and the arrow keys, each move announced, and resized from one to four columns.

Accordion.blurb: A set of Collapsibles with single- or multi-open policy.

ExpandableText.blurb: Clamps long text to a few lines, and only offers to show more when there is more to show.

ShowMoreList.blurb: Shows the first few items and a Show all button that moves focus to the first revealed item.

Carousel.blurb: Scroll-snap track + chevrons; the card band below xl.

CoverFlow.blurb: A carousel with depth. One transform per card from its signed distance, with stacking order taken from the absolute one.

CubeCarousel.blurb: Four faces on one cube. The whole cube turns, so the corners never come apart, and the rotation accumulates.

LayerStack.blurb: An exploded isometric stack. Two rotations on a shared parent, so the plates stay coplanar and every label is real text.

ScrollList.blurb: A scrolling list with masked edges, so a cut-off row fades instead of ending mid-pixel.

StackedCards.blurb: Cards that stick and pile up as you scroll. CSS does the stacking; one measurement a frame supplies the depth.

ScrollArea.blurb: A named, focusable scroll region with thin scrollbars and edges that fade only while there is more content past them, on either axis or both.

Masonry.blurb: Tiles of mixed height packed into columns set by its own width, kept in source order so what you see matches the reading and tab order.

InfiniteScroll.blurb: Loads more as the end comes into view, with a real Load more button as the fallback, the new count announced, and a retry when loading fails.

Dock.blurb: Tiles that swell towards the pointer as one curve, measured from the wrapper so the growth never feeds back into itself.

Navbar.blurb: The application header: brand, primary navigation, tools and an account control.

Sidebar.blurb: Full-width navigation column with grouped sections.

SidebarRail.blurb: The 42px icon rail with a pinned footer group.

Toolbar.blurb: Surface + IconButton cluster. The header utility group.

BackToTop.blurb: A floating button that appears past a threshold, returns to the top instantly under reduced motion, moves focus there, and can show a progress ring.

NavigationProgress.blurb: A slim top bar for route loads that trickles, finishes and fades, skips fast routes and holds still for reduced motion.

PriorityNav.blurb: A single row of links that moves whatever does not fit into More, keeping the current page in view as the width changes.

Breadcrumb.blurb: Text + Divider trail with an overflow rule.

MagicTabs.blurb: Tabs whose indicator measures and slides between them. SegmentedControl cross-fades a background; this one travels.

Pagination.blurb: ButtonGroup + IconButton with a page-window algorithm.

Stepper.blurb: Numbered progress through a flow; StatusDot + Text + Divider.

TabBar.blurb: Tabs laid out for a bottom bar.

Tabs.blurb: SegmentedControl + panels with correct tab semantics.

ArticlePager.blurb: Previous and next links with direction labels and titles, in a named nav. A lone link keeps its own side.

AlphabetIndex.blurb: An A–Z rail that jumps to a letter’s group and moves focus to its heading; empty letters stay in place, disabled, and touch users can drag along it.

CommandPalette.blurb: Modal + Combobox + Kbd over a command registry.

ContextMenu.blurb: Menu opened at the pointer, via Portal.

DropdownMenu.blurb: Menu with a trigger and keyboard navigation.

Menu.blurb: Surface(floating) + Button; owns open state, outside-click and Escape.

RadialMenu.blurb: Actions fanned on an arc, where every item is the same distance from the pointer. A vertical menu always favours its first item.

Menubar.blurb: A File / Edit / View bar that follows the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern: one tab stop, arrow keys across and down, submenus, checkable items, Escape returns focus.

MegaMenu.blurb: Site navigation that opens wide panels of grouped, described links, built as a disclosure with hover intent, one panel at a time and Escape to close.

LanguageSwitcher.blurb: Languages in their own words with English second, a lang attribute on each, a globe trigger and a filter once the list gets long.

VersionSwitcher.blurb: Docs version picker with Latest, Pre-release and Deprecated tags, plus a notice on old pages that links to the latest version.

ScopedSearch.blurb: Search with a scope picker inside the field and suggestions limited to that scope; typing in:issues sets the scope, and Enter searches with it.

RecentItems.blurb: Recently viewed docs, files and projects with time ago, pin, remove and clear, optionally saved to storage so it survives a reload.

Button.blurb: A native button plus token classes.

ButtonGroup.blurb: Segmented Buttons sharing one border and roving focus.

CopyButton.blurb: Puts a value on the clipboard and announces it - a glyph turning into a tick tells a screen reader nothing.

IconButton.blurb: Glyph-only button; the label is non-visual, so it is required.

SegmentedControl.blurb: The nav pill track — a single-select ButtonGroup.

ToggleGroup.blurb: On/off toggles in a row, each a real aria-pressed button. Unlike SegmentedControl, having none pressed is allowed.

ToggleButton.blurb: A single button that stays pressed, announced with aria-pressed, with Button’s variants and sizes, an optional icon swap and a label that never flips.

DownloadButton.blurb: One button from idle to progress ring, done and retry, with a cancel control, the file size in the label and each state change announced.

LikeButton.blurb: Toggle heart that updates at once and rolls back if saving fails. The count shows as 1.2k but is read out in full; no burst under reduced motion.

SocialLoginButtons.blurb: Continue-with buttons for six providers with single-colour marks, stacked or as an icon row, a last-used hint and a spinner on the one pressed.

VoteButtons.blurb: Upvote and downvote toggles with the score between; the vote shows at once and rolls back if the save fails; vertical or horizontal.

FollowButton.blurb: A Follow toggle that reads Following and shows Unfollow only on hover or focus, while the accessible name stays the same; optional follower count.

HoldToConfirm.blurb: A destructive action held rather than clicked. Spread commitment beats a dialog dismissed by reflex.

QuickActions.blurb: The icon-over-label action row from the balance card, with optional keyboard shortcuts shown on the controls rather than hidden in a help page.

ShimmerButton.blurb: A call to action with a sheen sweeping across it and a light that follows the pointer, written to CSS variables rather than to state.

SplitButton.blurb: A primary action with its alternatives beside it - two buttons with two names, not one button with a hot zone.

SpeedDial.blurb: A floating action button that opens into labelled secondary actions, with menu-button keyboard support, four directions, and labels shown or on hover.

ShareMenu.blurb: Hands off to navigator.share where it exists, otherwise a menu with copy link (confirmed in words) plus email, X, LinkedIn and Facebook links.

SelectionToolbar.blurb: A toolbar that floats above selected text; Alt+F10 moves focus into it, arrows move between buttons, and Escape returns focus.

UnsavedChangesBar.blurb: A bar that slides up while a form is dirty, with Discard that asks first, Save with a pending state, Ctrl+S or ⌘S, and an announcement.

AddToCalendar.blurb: A menu that adds an event to Google, Outlook.com, Office 365 or Yahoo, or downloads a correctly escaped .ics, with the event details shown first.

InlineEdit.blurb: Text that becomes a field on request: Enter saves, Escape restores, and focus returns to where it was.

Input.blurb: Wraps a native input; no label or validation opinions.

InputOTP.blurb: A row of single-character Inputs with paste and focus movement.

MentionInput.blurb: An @-mention list positioned at the caret, measured through a hidden mirror of the textarea.

PasswordStrength.blurb: A Meter and a rule checklist that say, in words, what would make a password stronger.

PinPad.blurb: A keypad and the physical keyboard as one control, where rejection is the return value rather than a ref reaching in.

SearchField.blurb: Input + icon adornment + clear affordance. The header search.

Textarea.blurb: Multi-line sibling of Input, sharing its chrome.

PhoneInput.blurb: Dial-code select joined to a national number that formats as you type, stored as one E.164 string, with a small overridable country list.

AddressInput.blurb: A postal address as autofill-ready parts, relabelled per country (State, County, ZIP code, Postcode), with an optional suggestions slot for your provider.

Checkbox.blurb: Native input with a drawn box; no layout or label of its own.

CheckboxGroup.blurb: Checkbox + Label + Field; owns the shared name and value array.

MultiSelect.blurb: Select + Chip list for the selected values.

Radio.blurb: A native radio with a drawn dot. Grouping and layout belong to RadioGroup.

RadioGroup.blurb: Radio + Label + Field; owns roving focus.

Rating.blurb: A radio group drawn as stars.

Select.blurb: Menu + Button trigger with listbox semantics. The currency pickers.

Switch.blurb: Native checkbox presented as a track and knob.

ChoiceCardGroup.blurb: Radios or checkboxes drawn as cards with title, description, icon and price, on real inputs so arrow keys and forms just work.

TransferList.blurb: Two filterable multi-select lists with move and move-all buttons, full keyboard marking and announced counts.

TreeSelect.blurb: Pick one or many from a hierarchy in a popover, with the tree keyboard model, a filter that opens matching branches, and tri-state parents.

CascadeSelect.blurb: Side-by-side columns from country to region to city in a popover; pointing or the arrow keys open the next level, and children can load on demand.

ColorSwatchPicker.blurb: One colour from a named palette as a radio group, each swatch announced by name, with a tick that picks black or white ink for contrast.

LikertScale.blurb: A survey matrix of statements against one scale, a labelled radio group per row, that turns into cards in narrow containers and shows progress.

SearchableCheckboxList.blurb: A long checkbox list with a filter, select all with a mixed state, a selected count and a selected-only view, rendering only the rows in view.

AmountField.blurb: Currency symbol + bare Input + currency Select, as Exchange Money uses twice. Keeps parsing and formatting in one place.

EmojiSlider.blurb: A rating where the face is the readout and the word is the aria-valuetext, because the number is an implementation detail.

Knob.blurb: A rotary control dragged vertically, not circularly — an angular drag spikes whenever the pointer crosses the centre.

NumberInput.blurb: Input + step controls; shares Slider’s clamping.

RangeSlider.blurb: Two Slider thumbs sharing one track.

Slider.blurb: Native range input restyled against the track tokens.

UnitInput.blurb: A number joined to a unit picker that converts the value when the unit changes, with limits per unit and arrow-key steps (Shift for ×10).

Calendar.blurb: Month grid with keyboard date navigation.

DatePicker.blurb: Calendar in a Popover, wired to a Field.

MonthPicker.blurb: A 4×3 month grid with year stepper, min and max, optional range mode and calendar-style arrow keys; works inline or in a Popover.

TimeSlotPicker.blurb: Day strip plus a grid of time slots with taken times struck through, radio semantics and the timezone always shown.

DateTimePicker.blurb: One field for a date and a time: type YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm or pick from Calendar and TimePicker, with whole-moment limits and the time zone shown.

DurationInput.blurb: Hours, minutes and optional seconds as spinbuttons, stored as seconds; arrows carry between units, and 1h 30m types or pastes straight in.

WeekdayPicker.blurb: Seven day toggles in the locale’s order with Intl names, plus Weekdays, Weekends and Every day shortcuts that follow the locale’s weekend.

TimeRangePicker.blurb: Two linked time pickers: the end always follows the start, moving the start keeps the length, and the duration is shown, with an optional overnight mode.

RecurrenceEditor.blurb: Repeat rules by day, week, month or year with end conditions, read back as a plain sentence and returned as an RRULE string.

ColorPicker.blurb: Area, hue and alpha controls in a Popover.

Cropper.blurb: A crop frame in fractions, not pixels, so it survives a resize. One box-shadow dims everything outside it.

FileUpload.blurb: Drop zone, file list and progress.

ShortcutRecorder.blurb: Records the next combination pressed, swallowing every key including the ones the browser wanted.

SignaturePad.blurb: Freehand with speed-varied width, smoothed through midpoints. Strokes are points, so undo and resize both repaint.

CreditCardInput.blurb: Card number, expiry and CVC as one control: detects brand, groups digits, checks Luhn and moves between parts as you type.

EmojiPicker.blurb: Searchable emoji grid with category tabs and recents, a built-in set of about 200 named emoji, and grid arrow-key navigation.

MarkdownEditor.blurb: Markdown with a formatting toolbar, Ctrl or ⌘ with B, I and K, and a preview built as React elements, so raw HTML and unsafe links stay inert.

AvatarUpload.blurb: A profile photo you click or drop an image onto, with type and size checks stated in words, an optional square crop, and preview URLs revoked when replaced.

CodeEditor.blurb: A code textarea with a synced line gutter, Tab and Shift+Tab indenting, auto-indent, paired brackets, and Esc then Tab to leave the field.

Field.blurb: Label + control + hint + error, with the id wiring in one place.

FilterBar.blurb: Chip and Select row with a clear-all action.

Form.blurb: Field layout and submission state; no validation library baked in.

Label.blurb: Form label on the type scale; owns the htmlFor association only.

ValidationSummary.blurb: The digest that takes focus when a submission is rejected — the only pattern that makes an error below the fold perceivable.

InputGroup.blurb: Joins text, icon, button or select addons to an Input with one shared border, radius and focus ring; passes Field wiring through.

RepeaterField.blurb: Repeating rows of fields with add, remove and move; focus goes somewhere sensible after every change, and each change is announced.

Avatar.blurb: Initials, tint and accessible name from one string.

AvatarGroup.blurb: Overlapping Avatars with an overflow count.

Badge.blurb: Short qualifier attached to something else.

Chip.blurb: Selectable or removable pill. Interactive counterpart to Tag.

IconTile.blurb: The rounded glyph plate at the start of a list row or a stat tile.

Kbd.blurb: A keyboard key. Pure typography and border tokens.

Tag.blurb: Static outlined label. Non-interactive counterpart to Chip.

ProfileCard.blurb: A person at a glance: cover, avatar, name as a real heading, bio, labelled stats and links, with a compact row variant for lists.

ActivityFeed.blurb: A transaction feed grouped by day with sticky headers and rows that expand in place, so the reader keeps their position.

BulkActionBar.blurb: Appears once rows are selected: how many, what can be done to them, and a way out - announced as it changes.

DataExplorer.blurb: A whole list screen — search, filters, sortable table and all four data states — wired together once.

DataTable.blurb: Table + sorting, selection, pagination and column state.

KanbanBoard.blurb: Column layout with drag and drop.

List.blurb: Layout wrapper owning row rhythm and separators.

ListItem.blurb: IconTile/Avatar + Text; the subscriptions and transactions row.

Table.blurb: Semantic table styled on the line and surface tokens.

TreeView.blurb: Recursive disclosure with full tree keyboard semantics.

VirtualList.blurb: Renders only the rows in view, so ten thousand items cost a few dozen nodes and are still announced as ten thousand.

FileList.blurb: File rows with a type glyph, readable size and date, upload progress or the error in words with Retry, optional selection and a row menu.

TreeTable.blurb: Nested rows under shared columns, with treegrid semantics, the tree keyboard model, expand and collapse all, and parent totals rolled up from leaves.

EditableTable.blurb: A spreadsheet-style grid: arrows move, typing or Enter edits, Enter commits down, Tab across, Escape restores, with a check on every cell.

Leaderboard.blurb: A ranking with shared ranks for ties, movement arrows, an optional podium for the top three, and your own row pinned when outside the top N.

LogViewer.blurb: A log tail with level chips and filters, highlighted search, copy per line, and a follow mode that pauses when you scroll up, across thousands of lines.

Metric.blurb: Text + Badge: a label, a figure and a delta.

MetricSpotlight.blurb: A KPI rail where selecting a tile drives a detail chart — the summary-then-detail dance every analytics screen reinvents.

StatCard.blurb: Surface(tile) + IconTile + Metric + Meter. The instalment tile.

KpiStrip.blurb: A row of headline metrics split by hairlines, each with a value, a change against the last period, an inverse option and a sparkline.

TrendDelta.blurb: Inline change like +12.4% or −3 pts: the arrow follows the sign, the inverse option only flips the colour, read aloud as up 12.4 percent.

AuditTrail.blurb: Who changed what, when, and what it was before — the field every implementation drops first.

DiffSummary.blurb: What is about to change, per field, before submitting. Cleared and newly set are their own facts.

JsonViewer.blurb: A payload as a collapsible tree in the code palette. Collapsing hides a branch; it never truncates a value.

MaskedValue.blurb: A sensitive value that is not in the DOM until revealed, hides itself again, and separates copy from reveal.

RelativeTime.blurb: "3 minutes ago", phrased by Intl in any locale and kept current, over a real time element with the exact moment.

ReviewSummary.blurb: Average stars, total and a 5→1 distribution whose bars are pressed-state filters, so the place you spot the 2-star reviews is where you open them.

ProductCard.blurb: Photo with a hover second shot, sale or new badge, struck-through old price, radio swatches, a wishlist toggle and an add-to-cart that reports its own result.

OrderTracker.blurb: Ordered → delivered as an ordered list with aria-current, step times, estimated delivery, and the tracking number one press from the clipboard.

EventCalendar.blurb: A month of events as chips on fixed-height days, with +n more opening the whole day, date-grid keys and a Monday or Sunday week start.

AgendaList.blurb: Upcoming events grouped under sticky day headings, named Today and Tomorrow, with empty days skipped and a now line through today.

CodeTabs.blurb: One snippet in tabs such as npm, pnpm and yarn, with copy, and a storage key that makes one choice switch and stay on every block.

WeekView.blurb: A seven-day hour grid with side-by-side overlaps, an all-day row, a now line and week paging, with events walked by arrow keys.

Receipt.blurb: A print-ready receipt that adds up line items, discounts, shipping and tax itself, shows the payment method, and has a slot for print and download.

QRCode.blurb: Encoded matrix rendered as SVG. The QR quick action.

ImageGallery.blurb: A main image with a thumbnail tablist, arrow keys, previous and next buttons and a counter; clicking opens Lightbox on the same image.

VideoPlayer.blurb: A video with labelled controls under the picture — seek, volume, captions, speed, full screen — and shortcuts that only work while focus is inside.

AudioPlayer.blurb: Spoken audio with play, seek, time and speed, a waveform that doubles as the seek bar, and a chapter list that marks what is playing.

TranscriptView.blurb: A timed transcript that highlights and follows the line being spoken, seeks on click, pauses following when you scroll, and searches in place.

BarChart.blurb: Categorical bars sharing the chart scaffolding.

LiveChart.blurb: A line that scrolls as samples land. One CSS transition per sample, and a scale that eases towards its bounds.

Sparkline.blurb: Inline SVG trend line; no axes, no chart runtime.

ScatterChart.blurb: X against Y with optional bubble size and a least-squares trend line, one tab stop with arrow keys to step through points in x order.

WaterfallChart.blurb: Floating bars from a starting value, with subtotals and totals computed rather than typed, so the bridge always adds up.

SlopeChart.blurb: Each item’s change between two moments as one line, with labels at both ends nudged apart, rise and fall tones, and focus that fades the rest.

DumbbellChart.blurb: Two values per category as dots joined by a bar, so the gap is what you see, with optional sorting by the biggest change.

ProgressChart.blurb: Stacked Progress bars for part-to-whole comparison.

RadialGauge.blurb: ProgressRing with a scale and a value readout.

BulletChart.blurb: Stephen Few’s bullet graph: a measure, its target and its range in one row, shaded in ink so it still reads in greyscale.

RadialBarChart.blurb: Concentric rings that each fill toward their own target or a shared one, labelled at the start, with the total in the centre and a legend.

BarList.blurb: Ranked horizontal bars as a real list - top pages, top referrers - the chart every dashboard actually needs.

CategoryBar.blurb: One bar split into its parts, with unused capacity and an optional limit marker. Lengths, not angles.

DonutChart.blurb: Part-to-whole arcs with a centre readout.

DotGlobe.blurb: A turning sphere of dots with places marked on it. A golden-angle spiral, because a lat/long grid bunches at the poles.

RadarChart.blurb: Several measures at once as a shape. Per-axis maxima, so measures on different units can share one outline.

Histogram.blurb: Raw values counted into bins with round edges, plus optional mean and median markers, because on skewed data the gap between them is the finding.

BoxPlot.blurb: Quartiles, whiskers at 1.5 IQR and each outlier as its own dot, from raw values or a given summary, vertical or horizontal.

MatrixHeatmap.blurb: A rows-by-columns grid on a stepped accent scale, with a legend, cell tooltips, printed values that stay readable, and arrow keys in two dimensions.

ParetoChart.blurb: Causes sorted largest first with a cumulative share line on its own axis, a dashed cutoff, and the long tail muted rather than dropped.

BeeswarmChart.blurb: Every observation as a dot on one axis, packed so none overlap, in rows per group with a median line and a highlighted point.

FunnelChart.blurb: Conversion through ordered steps: each bar against the start, each gap as the share that continued.

SankeyFlow.blurb: Where an amount comes from and goes, as ribbons whose thickness is the amount. Columns by longest path, so nothing flows backwards.

TreeMap.blurb: Part-to-whole by area, squarified so no tile becomes a sliver. Shows a long tail a donut cannot.

SunburstChart.blurb: Hierarchical data as concentric rings, with click-to-zoom into a branch, a breadcrumb back up, labels where they fit and arrow-key tree navigation.

NetworkGraph.blurb: Nodes and links laid out by a built-in force simulation that settles and stops, with draggable nodes, neighbour highlighting and a list of connections.

OrgChart.blurb: A top-down reporting tree of people cards with collapsible teams, elbow connectors, pan and zoom, and full tree keyboard support.

ActivityHeatmap.blurb: A calendar density grid. It answers a question no chart here answers well: when did this happen, across months, at a glance.

DaySchedule.blurb: A day of events with overlaps resolved by cluster and first-fit columns, positioned from minutes.

StatusStrip.blurb: The uptime strip, with missing data drawn as its own state rather than as an outage.

CandlestickChart.blurb: OHLC candles, hollow when up and solid when down as well as coloured, with a volume pane and a crosshair that prints the price.

GanttChart.blurb: Tasks as bars on a scrolling calendar by lane, with progress fills, dependency arrows, milestone diamonds, a today line and day, week or month zoom.

CohortRetention.blurb: The SaaS retention triangle as a real grid, with accent-shaded cells, a size-weighted average row, a percent or users switch and arrow-key navigation.

StreamGraph.blurb: Series stacked around a centred wiggle baseline with smooth edges; hover to isolate a stream and see every value, with legend toggles.

ChartTooltip.blurb: Tooltip specialised for a data point.

Legend.blurb: StatusDot + Text series key, shared by every chart.

GooeyLoader.blurb: Metaballs: blur the group, then push alpha through a steep contrast curve so overlapping edges fuse.

LoadingOverlay.blurb: Spinner over a scrim, scoped to a container.

Meter.blurb: Discrete, counted progress - eight pips of which three are filled, rather than a continuous bar.

Progress.blurb: Continuous bar, for values that are genuinely fractional.

ProgressRing.blurb: The same value drawn as an arc, for square slots.

Skeleton.blurb: Geometry plus a shimmer; no knowledge of what it stands in for.

Spinner.blurb: Leaf consumed by Button and IconButton.

UptimeBar.blurb: A 90-day status-page row with an incident tooltip per day and an uptime percentage that leaves out days with no data.

UploadQueue.blurb: Every upload in one panel: per-file progress, pause, resume, cancel and retry, overall progress by bytes, clear completed, and a collapsed pill.

SignalStrength.blurb: Four rising bars for connection quality with an optional quality word, announced as one image: Signal: good, 3 of 4 bars.

Alert.blurb: Surface + IconTile + Text; a persistent message block.

Banner.blurb: Full-width Alert with a dismiss action.

InlineMessage.blurb: The compact form of Alert, for use under a Field.

NotificationCenter.blurb: The panel behind the bell, with a real unread model announced through a badge rather than by colour.

Toast.blurb: Portal-mounted queue with timers and a live region.

MaintenanceNotice.blurb: Planned downtime in the reader’s own time zone with a countdown, turning to in progress and then completed by the clock, dismissed per window.

ErrorState.blurb: EmptyState with a retry action and error semantics.

StateView.blurb: One component for the four states every data region has. Every list rebuilds this branch, and each rebuild forgets one — usually the empty case.

NotFoundState.blurb: A 404 body that offers every way out: a large code, a search slot, the pages people usually meant, back and home, with the heading level set by prop.

AccessDeniedState.blurb: A 403 body that names what you tried to open, who owns it and which account you are using, with a request access button that becomes a sent state.

ConnectionBanner.blurb: Offline, reconnecting, and what is still queued. navigator.onLine is the default, not the authority — a dead API reads as online.

Countdown.blurb: Time remaining, in tiles - a silent timer role rather than a live region that talks every second.

RateLimitMeter.blurb: How much of a quota is gone and when it returns — recomputed from a deadline, so a throttled tab cannot drift.

RetryQueue.blurb: The changes that have not landed, with the backoff shown — a countdown is what stops everyone fighting the retry.

SaveIndicator.blurb: What autosave is doing, and when it last succeeded — the timestamp is what turns “Saved” into a claim.

SessionTimeout.blurb: The idle warning, with activity shared between tabs and a deadline held as a timestamp, so a sleeping laptop cannot cheat it.

IncidentTimeline.blurb: One incident’s updates newest first, with severity, affected components, and a duration that says Ongoing for until it is resolved.

StepLoader.blurb: A background job as a step checklist, with the current step and elapsed time in the header, a retry on the failed step, and a collapsible list.

UpdateAvailable.blurb: A new version prompt that asks rather than reloads: reload now, snooze for a while or skip until the next version, announced politely.

AchievementPop.blurb: Overshoot on the landing, and the shine sweeps after it — overlapping them wastes both.

StreakCounter.blurb: A flame that only flickers once today is banked, and keeps its final number when the streak ends.

XPBar.blurb: The overflow is the point: fill to full, snap to zero with the transition off, continue. Otherwise the bar sweeps backwards.

ActionSheet.blurb: Drawer anchored to the bottom, for touch.

AlertDialog.blurb: Modal with alertdialog semantics and a forced choice.

ConfirmDialog.blurb: AlertDialog with a standard confirm/cancel pair.

Drawer.blurb: Modal anchored to an edge. The mobile navigation panel.

Lightbox.blurb: Full-screen images with arrow keys, swipe and a spoken position, built the way Modal is.

Modal.blurb: Portal + FocusTrap in a centred Surface.

MorphDialog.blurb: A card that expands into a dialog from exactly where it sits, as a FLIP transform, so nothing relayouts mid-flight.

KeyboardShortcutsDialog.blurb: Every shortcut on one screen, grouped by area and opened with ?, with a filter and keys drawn for the device: ⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere.

PromptDialog.blurb: Asks for one value, like a rename or a new folder: opens with the text selected, checks as you type, submits on Enter and keeps a failed save open.

ReleaseNotesModal.blurb: What’s new, one highlight per page with media and a step indicator, shown once per version and remembered in storage, with a quiet opt-out.

FullscreenDialog.blurb: Fills the screen on phones and is a tall sheet on desktop, with close and save in the header, a scrolling body and a question before discarding changes.

HoverCard.blurb: Popover on hover intent rather than click.

Popover.blurb: Positioned Surface(floating); the shared anchor logic.

Tooltip.blurb: Surface(floating) + Text; replaces the native title on icon-only controls.

ConfirmPopover.blurb: An are-you-sure anchored to its trigger: focus lands on Cancel, Escape or an outside click backs out, and an async confirm stays pending and shows the error if it fails.

Toggletip.blurb: An info button that opens an explanation on click, Enter or Space and announces it. Unlike Tooltip it never needs hover and can hold links.

LinkPreview.blurb: A preview card shown after a short hover or focus, from props or an async loader; the link stays a normal link and the card never takes focus.

FloatingPanel.blurb: A non-modal panel dragged by its title bar or moved with arrow keys, kept inside the viewport, able to minimise, and reporting where it was left.

CoachTour.blurb: A guided tour that cuts a hole in the scrim over each target, scrolls it into view and anchors an explanation to it.

FeatureBeacon.blurb: A pulsing dot on a new control that explains itself in a small popover, saves Got it through a callback and holds still under reduced motion.

ChecklistPopover.blurb: An onboarding checklist behind a button that shows progress on the trigger, folds finished steps away and marks completion with a quiet tick.

PageTransition.blurb: Route-level enter and exit, built on Presence.

Parallax.blurb: Scroll-linked depth for a page region.

Reveal.blurb: Scroll-triggered entrance for a page region.

ScrollProgress.blurb: How far through a page or a container the reader is, coalesced to one measurement a frame, doubling as back-to-top.

ScrollVelocity.blurb: Skew, drift and squash driven by how fast you are scrolling, eased so a wheel burst reads as weight.

AnimatedList.blurb: Rows animate in when added and fold away when removed, matched by key. Focus moves off a leaving row, and nothing animates under reduced motion.

ScrollStory.blurb: Scrollytelling: text steps scroll past a sticky visual that follows the step being read, stacking on narrow screens and under reduced motion.

GlitchText.blurb: RGB channel tear that is clean ninety per cent of the time — and only one of the three copies is readable.

GradientText.blurb: A gradient sliding across live text. Duplicated end to end so the loop has no seam, and the glyphs stay selectable throughout.

RotatingWord.blurb: Cycles a word inside a headline.

TextReveal.blurb: A passage whose words light as it scrolls. Scroll-linked rather than triggered: the reader sets the pace and can scroll back.

Typewriter.blurb: Text that types, deletes and moves on. Announced once as static text, with the width of the longest phrase held open.

MarkerHighlight.blurb: A hand-drawn underline, highlight, circle or box drawn in behind real text as it scrolls into view, tinted from the accent; already drawn under reduced motion.

ShimmerText.blurb: A band of light sweeping across real, selectable text for Thinking… states, plain under reduced motion or when paused.

CircularText.blurb: Text set around a circle with a centre slot for a button; it turns slowly, pauses on hover or focus, and screen readers hear the phrase once.

MorphingText.blurb: Headline words that melt into each other through a blur-and-threshold filter; the word list is read once, and reduced motion keeps the first word.

AnimatedBeam.blurb: A curved connector between two real elements with light pulsing along it. It re-measures, so it survives a reflow.

AuroraSurface.blurb: Three drifting colour fields behind a container. Only transform animates, so a full-bleed hero holds 60fps where an animated filter would not.

BlobMorph.blurb: An organic outline on two unrelated sine frequencies, joined by Catmull–Rom, so it never repeats and never flattens.

BorderBeam.blurb: Light travelling round a border: one spinning conic gradient behind an inset opaque surface, so it holds at any aspect ratio.

HoloCard.blurb: Trading-card foil. The rainbow runs against the tilt, because real foil reflects a fixed light.

LiquidGlass.blurb: Glass that actually refracts: a blur, a specular rim, and an SVG displacement map that bends only the edge.

NeonSign.blurb: Three stacked glows rather than one blur, and a flicker that clusters its dropouts like a real tube.

OrbitRing.blurb: Items travelling a circle, each counter-rotating so it stays upright — the detail that stops logos arriving upside down.

ParticleField.blurb: A drifting constellation on a canvas, linked and pointer-reactive. Canvas, because the link pass is quadratic over positions.

RippleSurface.blurb: Water. Every drop keeps its own birth timestamp, so six ripples overlap correctly instead of restarting each other.

StickerPeel.blurb: A corner that lifts, casts a shadow on the sheet below, and comes off if you pull past the threshold.

Meteors.blurb: Decorative streaks falling diagonally behind content, pausing off screen and becoming faint fixed streaks under reduced motion.

AnimatedGrid.blurb: A background grid or dot pattern with a few cells softly lighting up in the accent, faded at the edges, and static under reduced motion.

AnimatedNumber.blurb: Tweens between two values. Owns an animation frame loop.

CountUp.blurb: AnimatedNumber triggered on entering the viewport.

SplitFlap.blurb: Split-flap board presentation of a value.

CursorAura.blurb: A cursor with mass that becomes the rectangle of whatever it hovers, and hides the real pointer while it does.

FlipCard.blurb: Two-faced Card with a flip transition.

Ripple.blurb: Pointer-origin ripple wrapper. Owns transient state.

AttentionShake.blurb: Shakes, pulses or bounces its child when a trigger value changes, or from a ref; under reduced motion it flashes an outline instead.

ImageCompare.blurb: Two states split by a handle. The top layer is clipped, not resized, so nothing reflows during the drag.

MarqueeSelect.blurb: Drag a rectangle to select. Items are found by attribute and measured once, at the start of the drag.

MiniMap.blurb: A scaled survey with the on-screen part outlined and draggable. Takes content coordinates, so it knows nothing about transforms.

PanZoom.blurb: A viewport you pan and zoom, anchored to the pointer. One affine step, so a minimap or a hit test on top stays tractable.

PullToRefresh.blurb: Drag past a threshold to reload, but only from the very top — the rule that stops it stealing an ordinary scroll.

SortableList.blurb: Drag to reorder, with rows measured once on grab. Space picks a row up and the arrows move it, announced through a live region.

StoryProgress.blurb: The segmented bar above a story. Re-keyed on the index, which is what makes a re-entered segment actually restart.

SwipeDeck.blurb: A stack of cards thrown left or right, with pointer capture for the gesture and arrow keys for everyone not holding a pointer.

SwipeRow.blurb: A row that slides aside to reveal actions that are always real buttons — focusing one opens the row.

ResizableBox.blurb: A box with right, bottom and corner handles that are focusable separators, with limits, arrow keys, and Shift to keep the shape.

SwipeToConfirm.blurb: A slide-to-confirm track that springs back if released early, with a keyboard route (End, or hold Enter or Space) plus pending and done states.

DropOverlay.blurb: A drop target that appears only while files are dragged over, checks type and size with a reason for every refusal, and always offers a choose-files button.

PresenceBar.blurb: Who is here, in a stable order a join cannot reshuffle, with arrivals announced rather than only drawn.

PresenceCursors.blurb: Other people’s pointers, glided between sparse updates by a CSS transition, positioned in fractions so a resize is free.

ReactionBar.blurb: Reactions with counts and a burst on pick. A toggle, not an increment, so a double tap cannot leave two likes.

TypingIndicator.blurb: Three dots and a sentence that is actually grammatical — one, two and many are three different shapes.

VibePoll.blurb: Results hidden until you vote, and each row is its own bar, so the label stays legible as the fill passes it.

ChatThread.blurb: Messages grouped by sender and time, with day dividers and delivery ticks. Follows new messages only while you are at the bottom, otherwise offers a jump.

MessageComposer.blurb: A growing chat input: Enter sends, attachments are removable chips, a character counter, and send is blocked while empty or already sending.

CommentThread.blurb: Threaded comments with a depth cap, inline reply and edit, reactions, delete with a confirm, collapsible replies and a resolve toggle.

ImageAnnotator.blurb: Numbered pins on an image with a note each, placed by click or a keyboard crosshair, stored as percentages so they stay put at any size.

QuestionQueue.blurb: Live Q&A with anonymous asking, upvotes, top or newest sorting, pinned and answered states, host moderation and politely announced new questions.

ApprovalChain.blurb: Parallel sign-off against a quorum, not a stepper. One rejection ends it however many approvals are in.

ConsentManager.blurb: Granular consent where rejecting is exactly as easy as accepting, and every recipient is named.

DataFreshness.blurb: When this data was last true, and whether that is still good enough. A failed refresh makes it older, not wrong.

ImportMapper.blurb: Column-to-field matching that guesses first, previews real values, and catches clashes while the file is still on screen.

PermissionGate.blurb: Shows a region to those who may see it and explains the refusal to those who may not. Silence is opt-in.

UndoStack.blurb: Undo and redo with the steps named, plus a history to jump back through. Leaves a focused field’s own undo alone.

SharePermissions.blurb: Invite by email with a role, change or remove access from one menu, and set link access with copy; the owner can never be removed.

VersionHistory.blurb: Document versions grouped by day, with a named-only filter, preview on select, compare with current, and restore after a confirmation.

AsciiImage.blurb: An image redrawn as characters, downscaled by the browser and mapped through a ramp ordered by ink.

BoidsFlock.blurb: Separation, alignment, cohesion — on a spatial grid, so two hundred boids is hundreds of checks and not forty thousand.

MatrixRain.blurb: Falling glyphs where the trail is accumulated residue, not a list of characters anyone tracks.

StarField.blurb: A perspective divide and nothing else, with streaks drawn between each star now and last frame.

GameOfLife.blurb: Conway’s Life on a canvas with play, step, clear, randomise and speed, drawing by mouse or keyboard, pausing off screen, and theme-aware colours.

FlowField.blurb: Particles drift along a seeded noise current and leave trails in theme colours, pausing off screen and holding a still frame under reduced motion.

AudioVisualizer.blurb: A real FFT from a real element or the microphone, trimmed to the part of the spectrum with anything in it.

PianoKeys.blurb: One oscillator per note with a ramped envelope, because a gain that jumps to 1 is a click.

Waveform.blurb: The bar visualiser, with a playhead. One scaleY keyframe per bar rather than a frame loop writing heights.

Metronome.blurb: A Web Audio metronome with slider, number field, tap tempo, time signatures and an accented first beat, booked ahead on the audio clock.

DiceRoller.blurb: The result is decided first and the tumble is arranged to arrive at it, not read off wherever it stopped.

GravityTags.blurb: Real elements that fall and stack, separated along the smaller overlap so the pile does not slide apart.

RopeCursor.blurb: Verlet integration: velocity is implied by position, which is what makes the constraint pass so simple.

SlotReels.blurb: Reels that land on a chosen result and stop left to right, because the stagger is the whole drama.

SpinWheel.blurb: A prize or decision wheel that picks the winner first, by weight or from the server, then slows onto it; announced, and instant under reduced motion.

FlipBook.blurb: Leaves with two faces, the back mirrored, and z-index taken from distance to the current spread.

PixelCanvas.blurb: A grid of buttons with interpolated strokes, storing palette indices rather than colours.

ScratchCard.blurb: A cover erased with the pointer to reveal what is under it, with a real button beside it, because a gesture is not an interface.

Terminal.blurb: History that preserves the half-typed draft, and a real input under the caret so IME and paste behave.

MemoryGame.blurb: Card-matching pairs on a keyboard-navigable grid, with moves, a timer and spoken matches. Cards change face in place under reduced motion.

TicTacToe.blurb: Noughts and crosses against a friend or a minimax computer, with arrow-key grid focus, squares named by position and mark, and a highlighted winning line.

CtaSection.blurb: The closing ask at the foot of a page, on the banner radius. Accent copy uses the derived accent-ink, so a deep brand colour gets white text.

FeatureGrid.blurb: Benefit-led features with glyph, name, one sentence and a “Learn more” that carries the feature name for assistive tech.

HeroSection.blurb: Announcement, promise, two actions and the product, on the display type scale. PromoBanner is an in-app card; this is the first screen of a site.

LogoCloud.blurb: Customer marks flattened to one tone, as a row, a hairline grid or a marquee — each exposed as an image named for the company.

SectionHeading.blurb: Eyebrow, display title and lede — the opening of every landing-page section, held to one measure so eight of them in a row do not drift.

SiteFooter.blurb: The site map: column titles as real headings, legal row, social links named for their network.

SiteHeader.blurb: The marketing top bar. Navbar is the signed-in app header; this is links out and a sign-up, transparent over the hero until the page scrolls.

TestimonialCard.blurb: A quote with the person attached, as figure, blockquote and figcaption — the only structure that says whose words they are.

FaqSection.blurb: Marketing FAQ with category filters, search across answers, hash links that open and focus a question, a contact area and optional FAQPage JSON-LD.

NewsletterSignup.blurb: Email capture as a card or inline row, with optional consent, check-your-inbox, already-subscribed and error states, and a hidden trap field for bots.

BillingToggle.blurb: Monthly or yearly, with the saving pinned beside the control rather than inside it, so the track never jumps.

FeatureComparison.blurb: The plan-by-feature matrix as a real table with row and group headers — and one plan at a time on a phone, instead of a sideways scroll.

PricingCard.blurb: One plan: price, the action directly under it, then the list. Excluded features are announced as excluded.

PricingTable.blurb: Plans behind a period switch. The yearly saving is computed from the plans, and the annual total that actually leaves the account is shown.

UsagePricingCalculator.blurb: A usage-based estimate with a slider and number per metered item, graduated or volume tiers, a breakdown, a yearly toggle and talk to sales past a limit.

AuthCard.blurb: The frame for sign in, sign up, reset and invite: providers, the rule, the form, the way out — and the error announced at the top.

OnboardingWizard.blurb: Multi-step setup that validates each step in place, revisits only completed steps, and moves focus to each new step’s heading.

SetupChecklist.blurb: The “get set up” card. Steps are props, so it advances when work is done elsewhere; optional steps never hold completion hostage.

EmailVerification.blurb: Check your inbox with a masked address, webmail links, resend with a countdown, change email, a code as an alternative, and a verified state.

OAuthConsent.blurb: An authorisation screen with publisher verification, the signed-in account with a switch, plain-language scopes with sensitive ones first, and the redirect host.

CheckoutSummary.blurb: Order lines, promo code, tax and what is due today — plus what is charged after today. Card entry is left to the provider’s hosted field.

InvoiceList.blurb: Billing history with Pay now in the row of any due or failed invoice, and downloads named for their invoice.

PaymentMethodCard.blurb: A saved card whose expiry is worked out, not displayed — and a default card that cannot be removed out from under a subscription.

PlanSummary.blurb: Current plan, status, and the one date that matters next. A failed payment is a warning with the fix inside it, not a badge.

UpgradePrompt.blurb: An upsell as a card, a top banner or inline where a gated feature would be, with a trial countdown derived from a date.

UsageMeter.blurb: Entitlements over a billing period — seats, storage, MAUs — with unlimited and over-the-limit as their own states. RateLimitMeter is the rolling window.

SeatSelector.blurb: Paid seats with a typed stepper that stops at seats in use, the new total, and today’s prorated charge with the arithmetic shown.

CancellationFlow.blurb: Honest cancellation: an optional reason, an offer that matches it, then a confirm listing what is lost and when access ends. The way out is never hidden.

InviteMembers.blurb: Paste a column of addresses, pick a role, see what it costs. Bad, duplicate and existing addresses are caught as chips before sending.

MemberList.blurb: People, roles and removal, enforcing the rule most team screens forget: a workspace can never lose its last owner.

RolePermissions.blurb: Roles against permissions as a checkbox matrix, every box named for its intersection, locked roles shown rather than hidden.

UserMenu.blurb: The account menu behind the avatar: identity above the menu rather than in it, settings, and a sign-out that is always last.

WorkspaceSwitcher.blurb: The multi-tenant switcher: a listbox in a popover with arrow keys, a check on the current one, search past six, and Create.

AccessRequests.blurb: Pending join requests with the requester’s note. Change the role before approving, deny with a reason, or select several at once.

ApiKeyManager.blurb: Create, list and revoke keys. The secret is shown once in a dialog that cannot be dismissed by accident; the list shows prefix and last use.

ChangelogList.blurb: Product updates as a changelog page or a compact “What’s new”, with anything newer than the last visit marked new.

DangerZone.blurb: Irreversible actions fenced off, confirmed with type-to-confirm, with any failure kept on the row that caused it.

HelpPanel.blurb: Search the docs, jump to resources, check system status, and reach a person — offered right at a dead-end search.

IntegrationCard.blurb: One marketplace tile with exactly one next step per state — Connect, Configure, Reconnect or Upgrade — and a broken connection shown as broken.

SettingsSection.blurb: A settings block with its own save bar that knows when something changed, plus SettingsRow for the label-and-switch lines.

WebhookDeliveries.blurb: The delivery log: every row opens to the exact payload and response, timeouts are their own outcome, and failures retry in place.

WebhookEndpoints.blurb: Webhook endpoints with three states, not two: an enabled endpoint answering 500 is shown as failing, with its last response, on its own row.

NotificationPreferences.blurb: Events by channel as a grid of labelled checkboxes, an all box per channel with a mixed state, a digest frequency, and a draft held until you save.

FeatureFlags.blurb: Flags with a switch per environment, a rollout slider, a stale marker and search. Turning one on in production asks first; turning it off never does.

DomainSetup.blurb: Custom domain setup: DNS records to copy, a check result on each record, SSL status, and removal that asks first.

LocaleSettings.blurb: Language, region, searchable time zone and format overrides, with a live preview line formatted through Intl and a draft saved on demand.

BrandingSettings.blurb: Logo and brand colour with a live preview themed by applyAccent on the preview only, a label contrast check, reset, and a save or discard draft.

FilterBuilder.blurb: Field, operator, value rows joined by all or any, with operators by type — plus matchesFilters, so table and builder agree on meaning.

SavedViews.blurb: Named filter sets above a table, with the unsaved state made explicit: save over it, save as new, or put it back.

DataExportPanel.blurb: Request an export by dataset, format and date range, then follow it from queued to ready, with download links and an expiry countdown.

AnnouncementBar.blurb: The strip across the top for a launch or maintenance, with dismissal remembered per announcement rather than globally.

CookieBanner.blurb: The first-visit consent prompt where Reject all is exactly as easy as Accept all. Opens ConsentManager for the detail.

FeedbackWidget.blurb: A face, a sentence and send. Either half is enough; the faces are real radios announced by their word.

ReferralCard.blurb: The offer first, then the invite link with copy and share, progress to the next reward in words, and each invited friend with their status.

NpsSurvey.blurb: The 0–10 question as real radios, a follow-up that changes with the score, a thank-you state and dismiss — as a card or inline.

RoadmapBoard.blurb: A public roadmap in Planned, In progress and Shipped, with instant vote toggles, comment counts, a tag filter, sort by votes, and tabs on small screens.

SessionList.blurb: Where the account is signed in, with location and IP, the current device pinned, and sign-out of everything else.

SsoSetup.blurb: SAML set up in real order — our values, theirs, test, enforce. Enforcement stays locked until a test passes against exactly the values on screen.

TwoFactorSetup.blurb: Scan, confirm with a code, keep the recovery codes — Done stays locked until the codes are stored, because a lost phone is a locked account.

IpAllowlist.blurb: An IPv4/IPv6 and CIDR allowlist that validates and normalises entries, confirms enforcement, and asks before the admin’s own IP gets locked out.
